english: Um...
H-huh?
Um, excuse me!\nIs there anything I could help with?
I'll give it my all, so\nplease take care of me!!
...Sure.\nUm... yeah, looking forward to it.
Oh, s-sorry! I haven't introduced myself yet!\nI'm Super Sonico!\nIt's nice to properly meet you!
You're right.\nWell, now that we're doing this properly... I'm [CLAUDE].
Uuuh...
Um, er, well...
Sorry...\nI never know what to talk about\nat times like this...
N-no!!\nI'm sorry for making you\ntiptoe around me like that!!
You're... the same way?!
I mean, how do I put it...\nYou really don't have to\nworry about it!
I'll do my best to open up\nto everyone soon!
...Yeah.\nThat's probably something I need to work on too.
Really?\nI thought you were fitting in\njust fine, though...
Nah... being the only guy here\nprobably doesn't help... it's hard\nto really open up.
I see.\nHehe. To think you have\nthe same worries as me...
We're birds of a feather!
No, no... I don't have\nthat sparkle you have, Sonico.
Sparkle...?\nUm...\nI'm not glowing anywhere, though...
...That's not what I mean...\nI mean how your smile makes\nother people happy, stuff like that...
R-really?\nEhehe... when you put it like that,\nit makes me kind of embarrassed...
But if that's how it works, then\nyou've got wonderful qualities too!
That I can heal, you mean...?\nI guess... I can at least\nhelp people out...
Oh, that's amazing too!\nThe fact that you can do that\nis proof you've got wonderful qualities!
A wonderful smile...?
Th-that does sound wonderful, but...\nsadly, I haven't gotten to see\nyour wonderful smile yet, so... um!
Your wonderful quality\nis your kind personality.
The fact that I can talk properly\neven now, while I'm nervous,\nis because you're so kind, I think.
Thank you.
...Y-yeah!\nH-hearing that... makes me blush.
Yeah...\nUm, I had fun talking with you!
Sonico, huh.\nShe's a really sweet girl.
(She kept her hands clasped in front of her chest... was that nerves?\nI hope the day comes when she can relax.)
Uuuh...?\nMy futon's a monster, I tell you~.
Sonico?\nA-are you... okay?
I'm fine~. Fwaah...\nI'm wide awake~.
Besides... if I don't wake up properly,\nI'll get left behind~...
...Nobody's leaving you behind.\nAnd there's no one over there.\nYou're still half asleep, aren't you...
Nnngh!\n...Come to think of it, I feel like\nI was eating ramen...
...That was probably a dream, right?\nYou were asleep just a moment ago.
...I'm finally waking up...\nUuuh... yeah, you're right... just a dream~...\nUuuh, I want ramen...
Ah! Ehehe... truth is, I just love\nramen... picturing it made me\nwant some a little.
By the way, do you\nlike ramen?
The orthodox kind... I guess?
Salt? Or soy sauce?\nOrthodox, so... it probably\ndepends on the shop, though...
Ah! So you mean you have\na favorite flavor for each shop?
Out of all ramen, I like knife-cut noodles.
Hmm, that's a little...\nI feel like that's not quite ramen...
But the more I think about it,\nthe more I really, really want some!
You really do love ramen, Sonico.
Yep! ♪\nI even named my kitties\nafter it, you know.
Cha, Shu, Men,\nNaruto, and Ajitama - five of them!
They're such cute kitties! ♪
Your love of ramen is the real deal, Sonico.\nSo... what else do you like?
Macarons! I love macarons!\nHuh? Haven't I told you that before?
They're French sweets, and\nthey're just so, so delicious!
The crispy crunch with\nthe sweet cream is just perfect...\nThey make me so happy!
And they're all so colorful and pretty,\nI can't pick just one, which is part of the fun!\nIt's great~♪
I-I see...?
Have you\never had a macaron?
No... I don't think so.\nI wouldn't even know what they look like.
What a waste! They're\nso delicious, I really\nwant you to try one!
Someday, if I get my hands on some,\nI'll share, okay?
Thank you.\nYou really do love them, huh.
Yes! Absolutely!
(Macarons... huh.\nThey must be a pretty common food\nin Sonico's world...)
Huh... where... am I...?
What's wrong, out here like this?
Ah!\nYou saved me~!
I went out for a little walk\nand lost track of where I was.
I wandered too far.
Out for a walk...?\nWhere were you even trying to go?
Um...\nI don't actually know...
You don't know?\nYou must've gone out for some reason?
I think so!\nI don't know the details, but\nI'm sure I had a purpose!
For example...\nmaybe I was looking for a home!
When I think of it that way, I\nwant to cheer them on, you know!
...Um... I'm losing the thread here.\nWe're talking about you, right?
Gyaaah! S-sorry!\nI got all mixed up!
I was chasing after a kitty.\nThere was a little kitty.
It was all alone out here, so\nI was wondering what was wrong~.
...I see.
That's right.
Um... let's head back\nto everyone.
R-right... got it.\nBut what about that cat?
I lost track of it...\nKitties sure are quick on\ntheir feet, aren't they.
(She sounds cheerful, but... she looks worried...)
Hm...?\nIs something wrong...?
...Huh? Oh, no. I'm fine.\nJust wondering what happened to that cat.
You're so kind.\nThe kitty... I'm worried, but...\nI'm sure it'll be fine!
Kitties may not look it, but\nthey're really, really strong!
Let's go.
I hope the kitten\nreunites with its mom safely.
Ah... that's the wrong way!\n...Wait... Sonico?\nWhat's that cat following behind you?
Huh?\nAh! It's the little kitty from before!
It can't find its home?\nBecause it ended up\nfollowing us...?
It followed us...?\nNo way...
When was that, exactly?\nMaybe we can figure out where it came from.
Um... I don't really know.\nWhen I noticed, it was\nby my luggage.
Did one of us feed it?\nMaybe that's why it followed us.
Fweeeeh!!\nH-how did you know?!
(Ah, so Sonico fed it...)
Anyway, understood.\nLet's take it with us until\nwe find its home.
R-really?! Even though\nthings are so hectic right now?
But you couldn't just leave it\nbehind, could you?
Y-yes...\nThank you.
Kitty, that's great~.\nNow we can look for\nyour home together~♪
(It seems happy, but...\nwhat world is this cat even from?\nIf I can't figure that out...)
The little kitty's acting strange!
Strange... what happened?
It keeps looking around,\nlike it's searching for something...
Maybe its home\nis nearby.
If so, that's great.\nIt can finally go home.
Yes!\nI want to find it soon!
Maybe it's just hungry...?\nShall I bring something?
No, that's not it.\nIt just had its meal!
But even if we look for\nthe little kitty's home,\nwhat should we do?
We have no clues.\nIf we knew something, we could search.
That's tough... finding a cat is hard enough,\nlet alone finding a cat's home...
...Little kitty.\nDo you know where your home is?
Meow.
Uuuh...\nIt must be around here.
I want to find it safely, but\nwhat should we do...
Meow!
L-little kitty!
That cat that wouldn't leave\nSonico's side...
Huh?\nLittle kitty...\nWhat about the kitties behind you?
Meow.
Are those the little kitty's family!\nThank goodness! They came to pick it up.
I'm sorry for dragging you\nall the way out here.
Now, don't get separated\nagain, okay.
Meow.
...They're gone.
Good thing it found\nits way home.
Yes!\n...But I'll miss it a little...
Meow.
L-little kitty?!\nWhat's wrong?
What's that in your mouth...?\nA guitar pick...?
Are you... giving it to me?
Meow.
Thank you!\nLittle kitty!
...I'm glad, Sonico.
Yes!
(She's clutching that pick so dearly...\nshe really is happy...)
(I never thought anyone could talk with cats, but...\nwith Sonico... somehow I can believe it.\nMaybe that's her strange charm.)
Uuuhhh!
Sonico?\nWhat's wrong?
I saw such a beautiful world.\nI was trying to remember it...
A beautiful world?
Yes! The fountain water\narched over the whole town,\nand it was stunningly beautiful.
I looked up, wondering at it,\nand the water caught the light and became\nrainbows... it was a town that never ended.
The people wore clothes like dresses,\nand they were all so lovely.
I changed into one too\nand strolled around town! ♪
(Could that be... another world?\nIs there another world out there somewhere?)
It was so beautiful that I found myself\nsinging as I walked...
People gradually gathered... ehehe,\nremembering it... is embarrassing...
They must've been drawn in\nby your singing, Sonico.
N-no, I'm still\nsuch a novice. Um...
Tell me more about it.\nWhat exactly happened...
Y-yes.\nUm, and then...
People gathered and I was embarrassed,\nbut everyone gave me applause.
So I was happy, and I kept\nsinging, and more. Then the people there\nbrought instruments and gathered around...
And then! They played\nimprovised music for me!
It was so fun!\nSinging felt amazing!
Isn't that incredible?\nPlaying improvised music\nto match a song!
A beautiful town, wonderful people,\nand fun songs.
It was such a wonderful world!
S-so...?\nWhat happened there?\nWhat happened after that?
A-after that?\nUm... I can't quite remember.
Got it!\nI'll go take another look\nat that world!
Once I've got a better sense\nof that world, I'll let you know!
Well then, excuse me!\nHup~!!
Ah, Sonico?!\n...Will she be okay on her own?
(So Sonico can travel\nfreely to that world?)
Listen to this!
W-what is it...?
I saw the continuation\nof that beautiful world!
An important person of that world\ncame and talked to me\nwhile I was singing!
Apparently, that world's precious treasure\nwas stolen, and strange things\nare happening...!
A precious treasure...?\nWhat could that be...
They didn't tell me\nthat much in detail...
But it seems I was chosen\nto take it back!
Saving a world in crisis felt\nlike too much for me, but\nthey relied on me and I couldn't refuse...
So I ended up going\non an adventure...
What a shocking twist!
Is that... really true?
Yes! I was so surprised, but\nit's really true!!
So that's your reason\nfor fighting...
M-my reason for fighting...?\nAwawa, it's not that\nbig a deal, maybe...!
Anyway, until I get that treasure back,\nmy adventure can't end!
Luckily, it seems I have\nthe power of song, and I could drive off\nthe enemies that attacked me along the way!
It seems to be a power\nno one else has!
Saving the world with the power of song -\nisn't that just wonderful? ♪
I've come to sing\nto save the world.
A-and then...?
Dragons and dwarves and lots of\nenemies tried to stop me, but\nwith the power of song I got through to them.
And so, my adventure continued!
...?\nDragons... dwarves...?\nUm... and after that?
Um, that's as far as it goes!\nI woke up right there.
I was curious about what came next too, but\nI happened to wake up\nright then...
Uuuh, what happened after that?\nDid I save the world properly?
When I see the rest,\nI'll tell you!
Ah... yeah.\nThanks...
(So it wasn't another world...\nit was a dream... I see.)
It's fun getting to see all these places!\nDon't you think so?
This situation...?
Yes! New places are exciting for\neveryone at first. But then you meet all kinds\nof new things there, get to know so many people...
Even if you don't know them at first, hup - you become\nfriends, and then they tell you about\nthe places they know...
I got so much power from everyone!\nSo being together with everyone\nis just really, really fun!!
You're always so bright, Sonico.\nI honestly... admire you.
W-wawa...!\nA-admire? I'm just...
This 'fun' feeling I got from everyone.\nI want to share that 'fun' feeling\nwith everyone!
So I'll do my best\nand send my power to everyone!
I could never do something like that.
That's not true!\nYou're already doing it!
That way of thinking... I think it's wonderful.
Th-thank you!\nEhehe...
...The fact that I can feel this happy now\nis all thanks to everyone!
And that includes\nyou, of course.
So I want to share\nthis happy feeling I'm feeling\nwith you too.
Once again,\nI'd like to properly thank everyone,\nso could I borrow some of your time?
It won't take much of your time!
N-no, really...\nWe're all in this together, so it's fine.
No, this is something I want to do!\nW-would it be a bother...?
A bother? Not at all.
Th-that's great!\nI'll think of something that'll\nmake everyone happy!
Just so you know, this is purely as thanks\nand to say I hope we keep getting along!
I want to do what I can\nfor everyone!
O-okay...\nYour feelings really make me happy.\nBut don't overdo it, okay?
Thank you for\nworrying about me!
Oookay!\nHere I go~!! Hupppp!
(A thank-you... I wonder what she'll do?\nI hope she doesn't overdo it...)
(I'm a little worried... I can't take my eyes off her...)
Found you!\nSo you were here! ♪
Sonico...?\nHuh?! That outfit?!
Huh? Gyaaah!!\nI came to get you like this by mistake.\nAuuuh... e-embarrassing...!
Hurry, this way!\nWe'll stand out here!
Huh? Where to...
To Cafe 'SHC'~!\nT-today, I-I'll be treating you!
T-treating me...?\nWhy all of a sudden...?
It's the thank-you we talked about!\nI wanted to do what\nI can for you!
And it seems cosplaying is\nthe rule here, so\nembarrassing as it is, this outfit...
Um, does it look weird...?\nIf so, I'll go change...
No, it doesn't look weird.\nIt really suits you.
R-really?!\nThank goodness~...
It's embarrassing, but I'll do my best!
Here's the menu!!
Um, isn't the menu the one you're holding...?\nThat looks like a tray...
Auh, I got them mixed up.\nHere it is!
Um... the chef's recommendation, please.\nI don't really know this place.
G-got it!\nLeave it to me!
Thanks for waiting!\nHere's the vegetable soup and nikujaga!
Um, did you make this, Sonico?
That's right~?\nIs something... off...?
...No, I'll dig in.\nAh, it's delicious...
Yay~♪\nGlad it suits your taste!
I'm actually good at cooking! ♪
(She can be a little spacey, so\nI was worried... but she's really good at cooking...)
And for dessert after the meal!\nMacarons~! Ehehe~♪
Please, please try one.\nThey're delicious~♪
...I'll have...
Staaare...
...Hehe. Won't you eat with me?\nIt's lonely eating alone.
I-is that okay?\nBut those are yours...
Eating together is tastier\nthan eating alone, after all.
Thank you! Ehehe...\nThen, I'll take you up on that... here I go!
Mmm!\nDelicious~♪
Yeah.
I think food tastes best\neaten with someone you trust!
S-someone you trust...
Ah! Um... that is.\n...I... um...
Huh? Um... I couldn't hear\nthe second half...
...Sonico...
Fueh?
...Ah... huh?\nWhere... is this...
Ah, sorry!\nDid I wake you...?
Sonico... did you change?
Huh? Um, I've been\ndressed like this the whole time...?
A dream...?
You had such a happy look on your face.\nI'm jealous~ what kind of dream was it?
...I see, so it was a dream.\nI think I was eating macarons.
Wawawa... a prophetic dream come true! Um,\n...which is to say! As thanks to everyone,\nI've prepared macarons! Ta-daa!
Here, please eat!\nThey're delicious~♪
Ah... it's true. A dream come true.\nWell then, I'll have...
Staaare...
Ah... hehe. A dream come true...\nSonico, won't you eat with me?
B-but, those are yours...
Eating together is tastier than eating alone.
Thank you! Ehehe...\nThen, I'll take you up on that...\nhere I go!
Mmm!\nDelicious!!\nRight?!
